name: Alboin
role: King of the Lombards from c. 560 to 572
contribution: King of the Lombards from about 560 until 572.
legacy: After gathering a large coalition of peoples, this person crossed the Julian Alps in 568, entering an almost undefended Italy.

checks.lead: Alboin (530s – 28 June 572) was king of the Lombards from about 560 until 572. During his reign the Lombards ended their migrations by settling in Italy, the northern part of which Alboin conquered between 569 and 572. He had a lasting effect on Italy and the Pannonian Basin; in the former, his invasion marked the beginning of centuries of Lombard rule, and in the latter, his defeat of the Gepids and his departure from Pannonia ended the dominance there of the Germanic peoples.
